name: Heriot-Watt University
description:
Heriot-Watt University is based in Edinburgh and was established in 1821 as the School of Arts of Edinburgh. It became a university in 1961 by royal charter and took its name from inventor James Watt and philanthropist George Heriot. Along with its main Edinburgh campus it has campuses in the Scottish Borders and Orkney as well as Dubai and Malaysia.

It hosts around 7,000 students and a third of these are international students from more than 150 countries around the world. It has been ranked in the top 300 global universities in the QS World University Rankings 2023. Itâ€™s also in the top 50 UK universities from the Complete University Guide and guides from The Guardian and The Times/Sunday Times.

What is the Heriot-Watt University acceptance rate for International Students?

The Heriot-Watt University acceptance rate is 80-85%.

Heriot-Watt University was named International University of the Year by The Times and Sunday Times Good University Guide 2018. It has also won an award from the Scottish Council of Development and Industry because of its international focus.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: When you choose Heriot-Watt University, you’re choosing an institution with a strong reputation for academic excellence. Heriot-Watt offers you a unique and enriching experience across various disciplines. Along with its main Edinburgh campus it has campuses in the Scottish Borders and Orkney as well as Dubai and Malaysia.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: The campuses provide you with a supportive and inclusive atmosphere. You’ll be among an international student community of over 7,000 students from 150+ countries. You’ll get a personalised learning experience due to small class sizes. Additionally, the university's comprehensive support services cater to your well-being, offering counselling, mental health support, and career guidance. Plus, the university hosts a wide range of clubs, societies, and sports teams that you can join to keep yourself busy.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
The university provides you with a range of accommodation options for different preferences and budgets. These include university-owned and third-party accommodations, close to the campus. You can choose from single rooms to shared rooms and private spaces, all equipped with modern facilities.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
The Cameron Smail Library is your study spot on campus. With over GBP 9 million invested in refurbishments, it offers you 700+ individual and group study spaces, 24/7 access, and access to online databases, journals, and university-licensed software.

Sports
At the Edinburgh campus, you'll find the state-of-the-art GBP 33 million facility, Oriam. It serves as a training hub for national teams, where you’ll get access to a FIFA-accredited indoor 3G pitch, a 12-court sports hall, 8 squash courts, and a strength and conditioning gym, among many other facilities.

Laboratory
On campus, you’ll find several specialised labs and research centres, including the Robotics Laboratory, the Learning Zone, and more.

Cafeteria
The campus offers you several dining options, including the Piece, Cafe Brio, Central Catering, Elements, and more. You can get quick bites and beverages from these spots.
